GOOD QUESTIONS

BEFORE YOU MOVE.

What is the minimum stay?

The concept offers one week, with seven days notice afterwards. Confirm a real facility's agreement.

Do I need insurance?

The brief requires contents cover, with a sample option from £3.50/week. No policy is sold here and the displayed unit prices exclude insurance.

What are the access hours?

Concept gate access is 24/7. Sample office hours are Monday to Friday 8:30 to 17:30, Saturday 9:00 to 16:00.

What cannot be stored?

The concept excludes living things, perishables, flammables, explosives and illegal items, including fuel, gas bottles and paint. Confirm the full policy with a real facility.

Can I change unit size later?

The concept allows free moves subject to availability. No live inventory or guaranteed transfer is provided here.

Is there parking?

Free parking and ground-floor loading are proposed facility features, not verified amenities.
